accepted.s: POSHAN Abhiyaan was launched on which occasion and at which place?
accepted.x: POSHAN Abhiyaan was launched on 8 March 2018 at Jhunjhunu in Rajasthan.
accepted.tq: Use the date-place combination to distinguish the launch from later campaign events.
accepted.sec: POSHAN Abhiyaan - launch, targets, Poshan Maah, Pakhwada, Tracker, Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi

accepted.s: POSHAN Abhiyaan is the abbreviated name of which of the following?
o: Prime Minister's Organisation for School Health and Nutrition
Programme for Overcoming Social Hardship and Nutrition
Public Scheme for Holistic Nutrition and Education
Prime Minister's Overarching Scheme for Holistic Nourishment
accepted.x: POSHAN stands for Prime Minister's Overarching Scheme for Holistic Nourishment.
accepted.tq: Test the exact expansion of an official programme name rather than its broad objective.
accepted.sec: POSHAN Abhiyaan - launch, targets, Poshan Maah, Pakhwada, Tracker, Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT a target associated with POSHAN Abhiyaan?
accepted.x: POSHAN Abhiyaan targets stunting, undernutrition or underweight, anaemia and low birth weight. Universal elimination of communicable diseases is not stated as its target.
accepted.tq: Find the option outside the programme's nutrition-specific target group.
accepted.sec: POSHAN Abhiyaan - launch, targets, Poshan Maah, Pakhwada, Tracker, Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding POSHAN Abhiyaan:
1. Its mission goal included reducing stunting to 25 percent by 2022.
2. It seeks to build a Suposhit Bharat.
3. It is intended to function as a Jan Andolan.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. POSHAN Abhiyaan envisages a Suposhit Bharat and a Jan Andolan, with the stated goal of reducing stunting to 25 percent by 2022.
accepted.tq: Check whether all statements describe the mission goal and implementation approach.
accepted.sec: POSHAN Abhiyaan - launch, targets, Poshan Maah, Pakhwada, Tracker, Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi

accepted.s: The 9th edition of Rashtriya Poshan Maah in 2026 was launched at:
accepted.x: The 9th edition of Rashtriya Poshan Maah was launched at Varanasi in 2026.
accepted.tq: Separate the venue of the 2026 edition from the original launch venue of POSHAN Abhiyaan.
accepted.sec: POSHAN Abhiyaan - launch, targets, Poshan Maah, Pakhwada, Tracker, Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi

accepted.s: The theme of the 9th edition of Rashtriya Poshan Maah was:
accepted.x: The theme was “Hamari Anganwadi Hamari Jimmedari”.
accepted.tq: Test the exact official wording of the campaign theme.
accepted.sec: POSHAN Abhiyaan - launch, targets, Poshan Maah, Pakhwada, Tracker, Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi

accepted.s: Which of the following was included among the pillars of the 2026 Rashtriya Poshan Maah?
accepted.x: The pillars of the 2026 Poshan Maah included ten years of the Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY).
accepted.tq: Identify the programme-specific pillar instead of a general development priority.
accepted.sec: POSHAN Abhiyaan - launch, targets, Poshan Maah, Pakhwada, Tracker, Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi

accepted.s:
With reference to Poshan Pakhwada, consider the following statements:
1. It is observed as a fortnight-long campaign.
2. Its 8th edition in 2026 focused on brain development during the first six years.
3. It is conducted exclusively for adolescent girls.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Poshan Pakhwada is a fortnight-long campaign, and its 8th edition in 2026 focused on brain development in the first six years. It is not exclusively for adolescent girls.
accepted.tq: Reject the exclusive-beneficiary trap and retain the duration and focus supported by the programme description.
accepted.sec: POSHAN Abhiyaan - launch, targets, Poshan Maah, Pakhwada, Tracker, Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the Poshan Tracker?
o: A financial audit system for State treasuries
A survey conducted once every ten years by the Registrar General
A portal for allocating parliamentary constituencies
An application for real-time monitoring of Anganwadi services and growth data
accepted.x: Poshan Tracker is a digital application that monitors Anganwadi services and growth-related data in real time.
accepted.tq: Match the digital tool with its precise administrative function.
accepted.sec: POSHAN Abhiyaan - launch, targets, Poshan Maah, Pakhwada, Tracker, Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi

accepted.s: Why should Poshan Tracker data not be treated as strictly comparable with NFHS survey data?
o: NFHS records only adult nutrition, whereas Poshan Tracker records only income.
Poshan Tracker covers only urban children, whereas NFHS covers only rural households.
Poshan Tracker is a census of children at Anganwadi centres, whereas NFHS is a survey.
Both datasets are collected exclusively through laboratory testing.
accepted.x: Poshan Tracker data represents a census of children enrolled or covered at Anganwadi centres, while NFHS data is survey-based; therefore, the two are not strictly comparable.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a census-type administrative dataset from a sample survey.
accepted.sec: POSHAN Abhiyaan - launch, targets, Poshan Maah, Pakhwada, Tracker, Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi

accepted.s: Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi primarily seeks to:
o: Bring early childhood care and education into Anganwadis through play-based pedagogy
Replace all Anganwadi workers with digital instructors
Introduce higher education in rural schools
accepted.x: Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi integrates ECCE into Anganwadis and promotes play-based pedagogy, effectively developing them as pre-schools.
accepted.tq: Identify the educational intervention from the age group and institutional setting involved.
accepted.sec: POSHAN Abhiyaan - launch, targets, Poshan Maah, Pakhwada, Tracker, Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Initiative)
 a. Poshan Tracker
 b. Poshan Vatika
 c. Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi
 d. Poshan Pakhwada

List-II (Feature)
 i. Nutrition gardens at Anganwadi centres
 ii. Brain development in the first six years
 iii. Real-time monitoring of Anganwadi services
 iv. ECCE and play-based pedagogy

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
accepted.x: Poshan Tracker relates to real-time monitoring, Poshan Vatika to nutrition gardens, Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi to ECCE and play-based pedagogy, and Poshan Pakhwada to brain development in the first six years.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure pair Poshan Vatika–nutrition gardens and eliminate codes.

accepted.s: Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0 was introduced in 2021 under the administrative control of:
o: Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
accepted.x: Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0 is administered by the Ministry of Women and Child Development and was introduced in 2021.
accepted.tq: Use the implementing ministry to distinguish the scheme from health and education programmes.
accepted.sec: POSHAN Abhiyaan - launch, targets, Poshan Maah, Pakhwada, Tracker, Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi

accepted.s: Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0 is a:
o: State Sector Scheme financed entirely by local bodies
Statutory welfare fund established by Parliament
Central Sector Scheme with no State contribution
accepted.x: Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0 is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between Central Sector and Centrally Sponsored scheme classifications.
accepted.sec: POSHAN Abhiyaan - launch, targets, Poshan Maah, Pakhwada, Tracker, Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi

accepted.s: Which one of the following funding patterns is correctly matched under Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0?
o: North-Eastern and Himalayan States and Jammu and Kashmir — 90:10
accepted.x: North-Eastern and Himalayan States and Jammu and Kashmir receive funding in the 90:10 pattern. Union Territories without legislature are funded 100 percent by the Centre.
accepted.tq: Check the category-specific ratio and reject reversed funding patterns.
accepted.sec: POSHAN Abhiyaan - launch, targets, Poshan Maah, Pakhwada, Tracker, Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the three verticals of Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0?
o: Universal secondary education for all adolescents
Nutrition support, including for adolescent girls
Early Childhood Care and Education for children aged 3–6 years
accepted.x: The three verticals are nutrition support, ECCE for children aged 3–6 years, and Anganwadi infrastructure. Universal secondary education is not one of them.
accepted.tq: Find the option outside the scheme's three-part structure.
accepted.sec: POSHAN Abhiyaan - launch, targets, Poshan Maah, Pakhwada, Tracker, Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi

accepted.s: Under the upgrading plan for Saksham Anganwadis, how many Anganwadi centres are being upgraded each year?
accepted.x: Two lakh Anganwadi centres are planned for upgrading, at a rate of 40,000 centres per year.
accepted.tq: Use the stated annual rate rather than the total multi-year target.
accepted.sec: POSHAN Abhiyaan - launch, targets, Poshan Maah, Pakhwada, Tracker, Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding nutrition support is correct?
o: Poshan Vatikas are exclusively urban nutrition laboratories.
Millets are supplied only during Poshan Pakhwada.
There are 43,500 Poshan Vatikas, and millets are prohibited in supplementary nutrition.
There are 4.35 lakh Poshan Vatikas, and millets are included in supplementary nutrition at least once a week.
accepted.x: The programme has 4.35 lakh Poshan Vatikas, and millets are provided at least once a week in supplementary nutrition.
accepted.tq: Combine the numerical figure with the precise frequency of millet inclusion.

accepted.s: Under the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006, the minimum legal age for marriage is:
o: 21 years for both girls and boys
18 years for girls and 21 years for boys
18 years for girls and 18 years for boys
21 years for girls and 18 years for boys
accepted.x: The Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 prescribes 18 years for girls and 21 years for boys.
accepted.tq: Directly discriminate between the two age thresholds in a commonly confused pair.
accepted.sec: Child marriage - PCMA 2006, Prohibition Officers, age bill, data, district models

accepted.s: An adult male who contracts, conducts or promotes a child marriage under the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 may be punished with:
o: Rigorous imprisonment up to two years and fine up to Rs. 1 lakh
Fine up to Rs. 10 lakh only
Simple imprisonment up to five years without fine
Imprisonment up to one year and fine up to Rs. 50,000
accepted.x: The punishment may extend to two years of rigorous imprisonment and a fine up to Rs. 1 lakh.
accepted.tq: Retain both components of the penalty instead of selecting a partially correct punishment.
accepted.sec: Child marriage - PCMA 2006, Prohibition Officers, age bill, data, district models

accepted.s: Who appoints the Child Marriage Prohibition Officers?
o: The National Commission for Protection of Child Rights
accepted.x: Child Marriage Prohibition Officers are appointed by State Governments.
accepted.tq: Ask which authority performs the appointment to avoid confusing it with a national commission's role.
accepted.sec: Child marriage - PCMA 2006, Prohibition Officers, age bill, data, district models

accepted.s: The Prohibition of Child Marriage (Amendment) Bill, 2021 proposed to raise the minimum marriageable age of women to 21 years. What happened to the Bill?
o: It was withdrawn after being passed by both Houses.
It was rejected by the Supreme Court.
It was enacted as an Act in 2022.
It was referred to a Standing Committee and lapsed with the 17th Lok Sabha.
accepted.x: The Bill was sent to a Standing Committee and subsequently lapsed with the 17th Lok Sabha.
accepted.tq: Track the legislative stage and final status rather than only the proposed reform.
accepted.sec: Child marriage - PCMA 2006, Prohibition Officers, age bill, data, district models

accepted.s: Which group of States was identified as having the highest levels of child marriage in the cited NFHS-5 data?
o: Tamil Nadu, Telangana and Andhra Pradesh
accepted.x: West Bengal, Bihar and Tripura were identified among the States with the highest child-marriage levels in the cited NFHS-5 data.
accepted.tq: Recall the complete three-State grouping rather than a single State.
